predecessor: Q17A PR #725 exact interventional identifiability PASS, without using its exposed C17_dev_a/b seeds
hypothesis: Fit two reusable causal edge-confidence variables from public interventions with ONLY the composed target A->C label as supervision; test whether their product predicts conjunction of causal edges more efficiently/accurately than strong equally informed learned flat, recurrent, symbolic and exact-oracle Bayesian controls.

causal_world.latent: two independent edge existence bits E_AB and E_BC with probability 1/2; target label T=E_AB AND E_BC
causal_world.public_episode: 16 intervention probes for A->B plus 16 probes for B->C, with uniformly chosen do(A=a)/do(B=b) and outcome matches action; public records only probe edge/type, action, outcome
causal_world.law: when edge is present P(outcome=intervened action)=4/5; when absent probability=1/2
causal_world.training_labels: only composed T available to all trained methods, NEVER the two edge existence labels
causal_world.inference: episode events only, hidden edge bits, target labels, generator seed and family identity unavailable

cohorts.predeclared_structure_balance: structure_index in [0,1,2,3] meaning E_AB=(index>>1)&1 E_BC=index&1; both labels available only to generator

candidate.name: LEARNED_FACTORIZED_CAUSAL_EDGES
candidate.form: P(T=1)=sigmoid(wA*centered_matchA+bA)*sigmoid(wB*centered_matchB+bB); two edge confidences fitted from composed-only label by Bernoulli NLL

recurrent.name: TRAINED_TWO_STATE_TANH_RNN
recurrent.form: for each public typed probe update only the matching one of two tanh states h_i=tanh(a_i*h_i+w_i*success_sign+b_i); output sigmoid(vA*hA+vB*hB+vAB*hA*hB+b)

symbolic.name: TRAINED_SYMBOLIC_TWO_THRESHOLD_AND
symbolic.form: grid fit both count thresholds from FIT labels, AND decisions; Laplace-smoothed positive probability for true/false symbolic decisions learned on FIT, with no oracle edge labels

bayes.name: ORACLE_BAYES_TWO_EDGE_POSTERIOR
bayes.form: exact P(E_AB=1|public probes)*P(E_BC=1|public probes) using explicitly known synthetic law and prior; privileged theoretical upper bound, not eligible to claim candidate advantage over oracle

training.select_restart: after epoch24 only; min frozen development loss among two restarts, no DEV gradient updates
training.loss: episode Bernoulli log-loss on composed target T, no intermediate edge labels
training.oracle_receives_extra_known_law: yes; separate upper bound, not matched empirical source information
training.runtime: measure full model training process_time and tracemalloc peak; development process CPU, final parameter/online-state count, serialize checkpoint bytes, include all attempts

hard_pass_all: candidate loss within 0.015 nats/episode of privileged exact Bayesian oracle
candidate improves loss vs both flat and 2state tanh recurrent by at least 0.010 nats/episode
candidate improves over trained symbolic AND by at least 0.010 nats/episode
candidate fit+DEV CPU <=1.10x trained recurrent on same host
candidate online state <=2 scalars; identical public FIT/DEV episodes across models

guardrails: No original-source episodes, no real MiniGrid/Pycolab, no CKB controller or queue writes
No Q17A reserved C17_hold_c/d or exposed dev cohorts reused
No Q15/Q16 holdout generation or model retuning
No independent transfer claims from training/dev synthetic sources
No full FORGE G61 regression bypass: source-only qualification separate
Do not run new held on failure
